dumps.title: Standard Wound Care Note Template
dumps.content: Wound care documentation should include: Patient identification, wound location and laterality, wound type/etiology, wound measurements (length x width x depth in cm), wound bed appearance (granulation %, slough %, eschar %), periwound skin condition, exudate type and amount, odor, pain level (0-10), infection signs, offloading/pressure redistribution, dressing applied, patient/caregiver education provided, plan of care and follow-up interval. Use objective clinical language. Document staging for pressure injuries per NPIAP guidelines.
